title: Germination and Dormancy of Seeds in Echinacea purpurea (L.) Moench (Asteraceae)
why: Abstract opened (Utah State repository record): gibberellic acid and ethephon raised germination and shortened mean germination time; prechilling helped in light and dark; 14 days at 4 C in 200 mg/L GA3 or 1 mM ethephon then 20/30 C light gave over 90%. The result sentences are all over 125 characters, so no evidence record could carry a whole-sentence quote; the full text may hold a short one.
get: journal via library; open record at digitalcommons.usu.edu/wild_facpub/1638
